note: Hand-collected from each college's own website on the retrieved date. Names, who an award is for, and how to be considered only: amounts, cutoffs and deadlines change every year, so the app links to the official page instead of stating them.

bright_futures.name: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship
bright_futures.source: Florida Department of Education, Office of Student Financial Assistance, "Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program: FAS/FMS Initial Eligibility Requirements" (last updated August 2025; applies to 2025-26 and 2026-27 graduates)
common: Submit the Florida Financial Aid Application (FFAA) no later than August 31 after high school graduation.
Graduate from a Florida high school with a standard diploma.
Complete the 16 college-preparatory courses: 4 English, 4 math (Algebra I or higher), 3 natural science (2 with lab), 3 social science, 2 world language in the same language.
bright_futures.hours_rule: Volunteer service hours, 100 paid work hours, or a combination totaling at least 100 hours.
bright_futures.changes: Requirements can change with each legislative session; confirm on the official site.
